title: Initial Health Appointment Copay
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — primary care onboarding standard**

The initial health appointment copay applies when visits the member's own primary care provider billed under the specialist visit copay are re-rated as primary care visits. It reads the visit log of the member's current assignment in the Primary Care Provider Assignment records over the 12-month re-rating window counted back from the review date.

## Standard

For each initial health appointment the current assignment's visit log records in the window, one re-rated visit re-rates at:

- **0.00 USD**, the initial-appointment copay, when the appointment took place within the **90** initial appointment days of the current assignment's effective date;
- **1.00 USD**, the late initial-appointment copay, when it took place later.

With no initial health appointment logged in the window, no visit re-rates under this standard.

## Counting the days

The days are calendar days counted from the current assignment's effective date to the date of the latest logged initial health appointment. An appointment on the 90th day after the effective date, or earlier, is within the 90 days; an appointment on the 91st day or later took place later. Every visit re-rated under this standard takes the copay that this day count gives.

## Condition and result

| Initial health appointments on the current assignment's log in the window | Days from effective date to the appointment | Re-rated copay for that many visits |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | 90 or fewer | 0.00 each |
| One or more | 91 or more | 1.00 each |
| None | — | No visit re-rated under this standard |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Effective date 1 March; initial health appointment on 30 May, the 90th day after it: within 90 days, re-rated at 0.00.
- Effective date 1 March; appointment on 31 May, the 91st day: later, re-rated at 1.00.
- No initial health appointment logged on the current assignment in the window: no visit re-rates under this standard.
